items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: You know when Nelson used to play for him... most of the time, it would be Lovin Nelson that was playing.

ctx.x: How did you get interested in music when you were a boy? What's your very first memory of remembering hearing music, bands, or singing, or what it was?

Well, I had a brother who used to get a lot of picnics out of Millen Boyd. And Mount Perez. You know when Nelson used to play for him. Quite natural when they'd have things like that, they had to carry the children along. So, I'd be out there and listening at the music.
